WITH equipment_averages AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry AS equipref,
         AVG(se.humepct) AS avg_humidity
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN scanenvironment se ON se.equipref = e.equipregistry
  GROUP BY e.equipregistry
),
reference_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS all_equipment_avg
  FROM equipment_averages
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref,
         ea.avg_humidity,
         ea.avg_humidity - ra.all_equipment_avg AS excess_humidity
  FROM equipment_averages ea
  CROSS JOIN reference_averages ra
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ra.all_equipment_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.avg_humidity > ra.all_equipment_avg
),
above_average_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS group_avg
  FROM above_average
)
SELECT aa.equipref,
       aa.avg_humidity,
       aa.excess_humidity,
       aa.avg_humidity - aam.group_avg AS difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_average aa
CROSS JOIN above_average_mean aam
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST,
         aa.equipref
LIMIT 10
